text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending a five-minute maximum parking limit, in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Elvina Gardens, between a point 19 metres east of Mount Pleasant Road and a point 13 metres further east. Within these limits Transportation Services also recommend a standing prohibition in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday to Friday. Currently, there is one-hour maximum parking limit in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the entire south side of Elvina Gardens.
